# The Art House Victoria Falls

> A private four bedroom self-catering house with a swimming pool at 360 Gibson Road, Victoria Falls, Zimbabwe. A 35-minute walk from the Victoria Falls, sleeping up to 8 guests, from US$350 per night. Hired out as a whole, with a private garden, original African art, yoga and Ayurveda with the host, Sara.

- Rated 9.4/10 on Booking.com (66 reviews) and 5.0/5 on Airbnb (13 reviews), as of October 2026.
- Phone: +263 77 260 6233 · Email: thearthousevf@gmail.com
- Check-in 2:00 pm, check-out 10:00 am. Minimum stay 2 nights (4 nights over major holidays).
- 4 bedrooms (2 king, 1 double, 1 twin), 3 bathrooms plus a guest toilet, private swimming pool, outdoor hot tub and shower, WiFi, smart TV, air conditioning, backup solar power and water, daily housekeeping, pets welcome.
